hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 ['Abdullah bin Muhammad] 우리에게 전했다 ['Utsman bin 'Umar] informed us [Yunus], 그리고 말했다 [Al Laits] 나에게 전했다 [Yunus] 부터 [Ibnu Syihab] 나에게 전했다 ['Abdullah bin Ka'ab] 그 [Ka'ab bin Malik] mengabarkan 에게 him 그 he ever 요구했다 the 빚 of Ibnu Abi Hadrad 부터 him 에 the 모스크 에 masa 알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를) 그러자 the voices of both of them rose until terdengar by 알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를) 누구 was 에 the 집. 그러자 알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를) 갔다 out 에게 meet both of them by lifting the 커튼 of his 방 그리고 calling Ka'ab bin Malik seraya 말했다: "O Ka'ab". So Ka'ab 대답했다: "Yes, O Messenger of Allah". So he signalled 함께 his 손, 위해 Ka'ab 에게 용서하다 그것의 절반. So Ka'ab 말했다: "I have 이미 offered it, O Messenger of Allah". 그러자 알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를) bersabda: "Rise 그리고 carry it out".
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 ['Abdullah bin Muhammad] 向我们讲述 ['Utsman bin 'Umar] informed us [Yunus], 和 说 [Al Laits] 向我讲述 [Yunus] 从 [Ibnu Syihab] 向我讲述 ['Abdullah bin Ka'ab] 那 [Ka'ab bin Malik] mengabarkan 向 him 那 he ever 追讨 the 债务 of Ibnu Abi Hadrad 从 him 在 the 清真寺 在 masa 安拉的使者（愿他平安） 然后 the voices of both of them rose until terdengar by 安拉的使者（愿他平安） 谁 was 在 the 房子. 然后 安拉的使者（愿他平安） 去 out 向 meet both of them by lifting the 帘子 of his 房间 和 calling Ka'ab bin Malik seraya 说: "O Ka'ab". So Ka'ab 回答: "Yes, O Messenger of Allah". So he signalled 与 his 手, 为 Ka'ab 向 免除 它的一半. So Ka'ab 说: "I have 已经 offered it, O Messenger of Allah". 然后 安拉的使者（愿他平安） bersabda: "Rise 和 carry it out".
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté ['Abdullah bin Muhammad] Nous a raconté ['Utsman bin 'Umar] informed us [Yunus], et a dit [Al Laits] M'a raconté [Yunus] de [Ibnu Syihab] M'a raconté ['Abdullah bin Ka'ab] que [Ka'ab bin Malik] mengabarkan à him que he ever a réclamé the dette of Ibnu Abi Hadrad de him dans the mosquée dans masa Le Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui puis the voices of both of them rose until terdengar by Le Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui qui was dans the maison. puis Le Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui est allé out à meet both of them by lifting the rideau of his chambre et calling Ka'ab bin Malik seraya a dit: "O Ka'ab". So Ka'ab a répondu: "Yes, O Messenger of Allah". So he signalled avec his main, pour Ka'ab à pardonner sa moitié. So Ka'ab a dit: "I have déjà offered it, O Messenger of Allah". puis Le Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui bersabda: "Rise et carry it out".
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt ['Abdullah bin Muhammad] Hat uns erzählt ['Utsman bin 'Umar] informed us [Yunus], und sagte [Al Laits] Hat mir erzählt [Yunus] von [Ibnu Syihab] Hat mir erzählt ['Abdullah bin Ka'ab] dass [Ka'ab bin Malik] mengabarkan zu him dass he ever forderte the Schuld of Ibnu Abi Hadrad von him in the Moschee in masa Der Gesandte Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm dann the voices of both of them rose until terdengar by Der Gesandte Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm wer was in the Haus. dann Der Gesandte Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm ging out zu meet both of them by lifting the Vorhang of his Zimmer und calling Ka'ab bin Malik seraya sagte: "O Ka'ab". So Ka'ab antwortete: "Yes, O Messenger of Allah". So he signalled mit his Hand, für Ka'ab zu erlassen seine Hälfte. So Ka'ab sagte: "I have bereits offered it, O Messenger of Allah". dann Der Gesandte Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm bersabda: "Rise und carry it out".
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato ['Abdullah bin Muhammad] Ci ha narrato ['Utsman bin 'Umar] informed us [Yunus], e ha detto [Al Laits] Mi ha narrato [Yunus] da [Ibnu Syihab] Mi ha narrato ['Abdullah bin Ka'ab] che [Ka'ab bin Malik] mengabarkan a him che he ever ha chiesto the debito of Ibnu Abi Hadrad da him in the moschea in masa Il Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui poi the voices of both of them rose until terdengar by Il Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui chi was in the casa. poi Il Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui è andato out a meet both of them by lifting the tenda of his stanza e calling Ka'ab bin Malik seraya ha detto: "O Ka'ab". So Ka'ab ha risposto: "Yes, O Messenger of Allah". So he signalled con his mano, per Ka'ab a condonare la sua metà. So Ka'ab ha detto: "I have già offered it, O Messenger of Allah". poi Il Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui bersabda: "Rise e carry it out".
